name: City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, November 07, 2017 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Mayor Waronek
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-f be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Special Meetings of October 16, 2017 and October 17, 2017 and the Regular Meeting of October 17, 2017
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
Consideration of a Residential Street Tree Request Program
ACTION: Authorize the Public Works Department to implement a Residential Street Tree Request Program whereby residents can apply for a street tree to be installed in the parkway in front of their property.
Item #7d
e.
Agreement with MSW Consultants to Provide Review and Negotiation Assistance for a Possible Solid Waste Franchise Agreement Extension
ACTION: Authorize the City Manager to enter into an agreement with MSW Consultants to provide review and negotiation assistance for a possible solid waste franchise agreement extension.
Item #7e
f.
Approval of Amendment No. 3 to Agreement with Hazen and Sawyer for the Cypress Water Production Facility Upgrades Project.
ACTION: That the City Council:
1.
Approve Amendment No. 3 to Professional Services Agreement with Hazen and Sawyer Engineers and Scientists for the Cypress Water Production Facility Upgrades Project in the amount of $287,560; and
2.
Budget an additional $102,358 for the project in the 2017-18 budget, as outlined in the fiscal impact section; and
3.
Provide feedback on potential funding sources for construction of Granular Activated Carbon Filtration at the Cypress Water Production Facility.
Item #7f
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
DISCUSSION REGARDING THE CALTRANS FEASIBILITY STUDY FOR REMOVAL OF ON-STREET PARKING ON PACIFIC COAST HIGHWAY
Presented by Public Works Director McAvoy
ACTION: That the City Council hold a public hearing soliciting feedback from the public regarding the elimination of on-street parking on Pacific Coast Highway; and provide direction to staff on next steps.
Item #8
9.
SCHEDULE JOINT MEETING WITH THE RAILROAD MUSEUM BOARD AND CITY COUNCIL
Presented by Parks and Recreation Director Harding
ACTION: That the City Council set a date and time for a joint meeting with the Railroad Museum Board.
Item #9
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
10.
PUBLIC HEARING - CLARIFIY AND EXPAND CITY'S EXISTING PROHIBITION OF CANNABIS ACTIVITIES CITYWIDE
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
ORD NO. 793 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita, amending Title XI of the Lomita Municipal Code to clarify and expand the City's existing prohibition on commercial cannabis activities citywide to cover both medical and non-medical commercial cannabis activities and declaring it a public nuisance and setting a separate penalty schedule for violations of the Chapter. (First Reading) ACTION: That after conducting the public hearing and after the City Attorney reads the title that the City Council introduce on first reading of an ordinance amending Sec. 11-1.15.03(C), Sec. 11-1.15.04(D), Sec. 11-1.15.13(M), Sec. 11-1.15.16(P), Sec. 11-1.15.18(R), Sec. 11-1.41.02, Sec. 11-1.45.02, Sec. 11-1.48.02, Sec. 11-1.49.02, Sec. 11-1.51.02, and Article 83, Part 9 of Chapter 1 of Title XI to clarify and expand the City's existing prohibition on cannabis activities Citywide to cover both medical and nonmedical commercial cannabis activities and declaring it a public nuisance and setting a separate penalty schedule for violations of the Article; and direct staff to schedule a second reading of the ordinance for December 5, 2017.
Item #10
11.
PUBLIC HEARING - ORDINANCE RE: PUBLIC EDUCATIONAL AND GOVERNMENTAL ACCESS CHANNEL FACILITIES (PEG) FEE
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
ORD NO. 794 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California amending Title XII, Chapter 1, Section 12 of the City of Lomita Municipal Code, Regulating State-Issued Cable Television Franchises. (First Reading)
ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council: 1) introduce on first reading an ordinance amending Title XII, Chapter 1, Section 12 of the Lomita Municipal Code pertaining to state-issued cable television franchises and PEG fees; and 2) direct staff to schedule a second reading of the ordinance for December 5, 2017.
Item #11
12.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned to the Regular Meeting to be held on Tuesday, December 5, 2017, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA. Please note that the Regular City Council meeting for November 21, 2017 has been cancelled.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
